# VSCode Light Modern

VSCode Light Modern is a light palette modelled on VS Code Light Modern and tuned for macOS, with low-saturation syntax colours and a macOS-first font stack of SF Pro for the UI and SF Mono or Menlo for the editor. Its recorded description describes a compact editor at 13px monospace with tight tabs and neutral borders, plus light-mode styling for headings, links, inline code, callouts, checkboxes, graph view, canvas, Calendar and Dataview blocks.

![VSCode Light Modern screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yangsonhung/obsidian-vscode-light-modern/HEAD/screenshot.png)

Keep a compact editor feel with 13px monospace text, tight tabs, neutral borders, and light-mode styling for headings, links, inline code, callouts, checkboxes, graph view, canvas, Calendar and Dataview blocks."
